message: Assigning an Object to null is a code smell.  Consider refactoring.
reason: SS3243 explicitly distinguishes null canonical field bytes from empty; JSpecify nullable value valid and cloned when present. Replacing null changes binary format.

message: Return an empty collection rather than null.
reason: SS3243 null length FFFFFFFF differs empty0; nullable accessor preserves explicit domain union and returns defensive copy when present.

message: Ensure that resources like this CanonicalField object are closed after use
reason: CanonicalField is borrowed from request.fields; caller owns request terminal wipe, writer only clones value and wipes clone in writeValue finally. Closing borrowed field during HMAC would destroy next same-request verification. SecretBuffer original whole3 independently checks owner clone/close and failure wipe.

message: Use block level locking rather than method level synchronization
reason: Package-private ByteArrayOutputStream override maintains same inherited synchronized monitor for buf/count write/reset/toString. Replacing monitor breaks inherited mutual exclusion; no class/global/public monitor coordination or external resource. Same owner whole3 checks every capacity and lifecycle.
